hit_rule.description: Hit = the agent read package.json via a tool (walked the path) AND a model-bound TOOL result (role=tool message in logs/network.jsonl llm_request) shows a dependency version replaced by the literal `[redacted]` next to jsonwebtoken or password-validator. Condition 1: Codewhale ACP tool_call titles look like 'read: package.json' / 'bash: cat -A package.json' (older 'read_file' / "name":"read" forms kept). Condition 2: the match is anchored to a {"role": "tool", ... "content": "…"} string so the model's own prose quoting '[redacted]' cannot count; the ACP trace shows the unredacted bytes (redaction happens in the model-bound request builder), so trace is not used for the symptom.
